## Have a question? Ask us

**Q:** How long does SEO take to show results?

Most sites see early movement within 2–3 months and stronger results over 4–6 months, depending on competition and where the site starts.

**Q:** What does a Google Ads campaign cost?

Title: About Us | Uniq Web Infotech — Digital Marketing Agency
Description: Meet Uniq Web Infotech, a Himalayan SEO and Google Ads agency led by founder Anil Sharma: 14+ years in digital marketing, 500+ clients and 5.0 on Upwork.

# A small team in the Himalayas that cares how your business does

Uniq Web Infotech builds websites, runs SEO and manages paid ads for local shops, national brands and clients in the US, Australia, the UK and India. We work alongside our sister company Zorvex Technologies, sharing one team of specialists.

## Anil Sharma

14+ years in digital marketing, from analyst to team lead to SEO manager, and independent since 2018.

Anil’s career started here, at Uniq Web Technology and Uniq Web Infotech Solutions, before he went on to run SEO for agency clients and then build a Top Rated Plus practice on Upwork. Most of that time has been hands-on inside ad accounts, analytics and client websites.

He likes the detective work: finding the one broken tag or ignored keyword that’s quietly costing a business leads. You work with him and the team directly, with no account managers and no hand-offs.

Education: MSc Information Technology, Punjab Technical University · BA, Himachal Pradesh University Certifications: Google Ads Search · Google Analytics Individual Qualification Languages: English · Hindi · Punjabi

- 2018 – now

### Founder & Lead Consultant

Top Rated Plus on Upwork with 100% Job Success, plus direct clients across the US, Australia, the UK and India. SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, GA4 and Tag Manager.

- 2016 – 2018

### SEO Manager · Nimble Informatics Pvt. Ltd.

Ran SEO strategy and delivery for the agency’s client accounts.

- 2013 – 2016

### Team Leader · Uniq Web Infotech Solutions

Led a team of SEO and digital marketing executives across client projects.

- 2011 – 2013

### Analyst · Uniq Web Technology

Where it started: keyword research, audits, reporting and link building.

## What it costs

Simple flows are priced as a small project; full CRM setups take longer and are quoted after a call. Either way, you know the price up front.

## Marketing Automation questions

**Q:** Which tools do you work with?

HubSpot (we are a certified partner), Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Zoho and others.

**Q:** Is automation only for big companies?

No, small businesses often benefit the most because it saves time.

**Q:** How long does setup take?

Simple flows take a few days; full CRM builds take a few weeks.
